_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of a city, the modern Ujjain in Mālvā, the capital
 of Vikramāditya. It is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus (<ab>cf.</ab>
 {#avanti#}), and the first meridian of their geographers from which they
 calculate longitude; {#sODotsaNgapraRayavimuKo mAsma BUrujjayinyAH#} <ls>Me. 27</ls>.
